calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark asset, subtract the trailing 15-day return ending five sessions ago from the recent five-day return, then cross-sectionally median demean. Positive values indicate strengthening momentum and negative values indicate deceleration. Signal uses only completed observations available at the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day predictive power passes the benchmark-wide gates, while 1-day and 5-day decay horizons fail. The usable signal matrix is sparse because rolling windows and median demeaning require valid history; recent 2027 observations were weaker than the aggregate sample, so use conservatively.
